changes.title: Build the selected machine wrapper through the root entrypoint
changes.detail: A supervised Core update needs its machine identity and packages, not just the generic Core layer. Validate the selected machine against the pinned architecture inventory before building its existing wrapper.
changes.detail_yue: 受管理嘅 Core 更新要有自己機型身份同套件，唔可以淨係拎通用底層頂上。先對實機型清單，再用原有包裝建置。

changes.title: Support source-bound manual Core delivery
changes.detail: A Core update should not wait for unrelated appliance builds. Stamp numbered source exports through the normal build entrypoint, remove workstation identity from the image marker, and reserve full publication for explicit dispatch. Preserve all untouched update-feed targets.
changes.detail_yue: Core 更新唔使排隊等無關嘅機器映像。正常建置入口負責版本同源碼標記，唔再塞電腦身份入映像；完整發佈改由手動啟動，其他更新目標原封保留。

changes.title: Record everyday workflow delivery and remaining verification
changes.detail: Keep the handoff honest: source is integrated, the live update button and final verification remain ahead.
changes.detail_yue: 交接寫清楚：源碼已合併，實際更新按鈕同最後驗證仲未完成，唔好搶先報喜。

changes.title: Keep script mode controls and condition results readable
changes.detail: Persistent condition results now live beneath their summary instead of borrowing an overlay slot. The script mode row stays reachable while scrolling and measures its height for the search offset. Tests and built verification follow the prioritized update.
changes.detail_yue: 條件結果唔再借浮層個位遮住文字；腳本模式列捲動時留喺可見位置，搜尋列跟實際高度讓位。先更新，之後先做測試同實際畫面驗證。

changes.title: Add bounded history comparison and isolate pending requests
changes.detail: History can compare an earlier window without letting an old response climb back into a newer chart. Reuse the numeric comparison pipeline, preserve original CSV records, and invalidate callbacks after configuration or lifecycle changes. Source reviewed; tests and runtime verification follow the prioritized live update.
changes.detail_yue: 歷史圖可以對比早前時段，舊請求唔可以返嚟搶新圖嘅位。保留原始匯出資料，轉設定或者離開頁面就令舊回覆失效。已做源碼覆核，測試同實際驗證留喺優先更新之後。
